blurb: Two aboard, a driver and a passenger shooting their own weapon; players on foot at its back resupply from it (ammo and grenades, ten times, then it is empty until it respawns)

notes.model: A Meshy Community sci-fi buggy (Meshy_AI__1108120754, CC0; content/guns.json vehicles/sixer_buggy.glb, 2026-11-11): a tube-frame four-wheeler with a cage over the cabin and an open deck behind it. It rides on the owner's Rugged Off-Road Tire (vehicles/offroad_tire.glb), one at each hub (2026-11-12): the body's own tires are cut out of it and dropped (guns.json `parts`, `drop`), since cut out as parts they took bodywork with them and spun off their axles. Hubs and size measured on the body's old tires: 0.5 m radius, 0.45 m wide, hubs 0.5 m up at x ±1.14, z 1.53 and -1.47; the body's lowest point left (its chassis) is 0.258 m up (`rideHeight`). It was the Buggy from 2026-11-11 to 2026-11-13; the owner split it off ("the new buggy should be only a 2 seater, but players can go to the back and resupply from it (limited supply, 10x resupplies?)"). The Tactical Off-Road Beast is the fallback (vehicles/offroad_buggy.glb) and the Buggy again.
notes.half: Fitted across the tires (2026-11-11, as the Troop Truck's): 2.9 m wide, so walls stop the tires where they are drawn and rounds that hit a tire hit the buggy. Length and height unchanged: the model is 4.4 m long and 1.98 m tall; its body is about 1.8 m wide and its tires stand out to 2.86 m.
notes.seats: Measured on the model (slices of its triangles): two front seats, cushions 0.82 m up at z 0.08 and 0.4 m either side (the floor 0.6 m up, the wheel on the left); behind the cabin's hoop (z -0.6) an open deck 1.7 m up from z -0.6 to -1.45, with a rack box on its left side (2.0 m): the supply load. Nobody rides on it; it is where players on foot resupply (`resupply`).
notes.cockpitEye: A seated head height (1.5 m), under the cage's front bar (1.6 m at z 0.4), looking over the wheel and dash. Up close the driver sees an in-house cockpit instead of the body's own (client content/cockpits.ts), refitted to this body.
notes.vehicle: The Warthog feel: soft, long-travel springs (bouncy, leans out of turns), loose at speed so it powerslides. The suspension's contact points and hub height are the old buggy's (unchanged handling); the tires are drawn at this body's hubs (`wheels.at`), each riding the nearest contact point's spring.
notes.resupply: Owner, 2026-11-12: ten resupplies from its back. The reach point is the tailgate (z -2.2, behind the deck's rack, 1 m up); players on foot within 1.6 m of it press Use there (instead of getting in). Each use gives what a resupply gives (sim/resupply.ts: every carried gun's reserve full, underbarrel rounds full, grenades topped up), with a short wait per player.
